instructions: This fork's work is in client-v2/; hold it to client-v2/CLAUDE.md. client/, server/ and wasm/ are upstream's code and arrive through chore(upstream) sync PRs: review them for merge correctness only, do not propose refactors there. Specs are the contract: for a client-v2 change, read openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md for each capability the PR touches, and openspec/changes/<name>/ (proposal.md, specs/, tasks.md) when the PR names an open change. Closed changes live under openspec/changes/archive/<date>-<name>/; when a PR edits code that an archived change introduced, read that change's proposal.md and design.md for the reasoning before calling the code wrong. Every #### Scenario in a spec is either a Playwright test in client-v2/e2e/ or marked (manual); flag a behaviour change with neither.
